title: Generated API types: what is typed and what is not
decision: Types only, not a generated client; the existing request code is kept. Six read operations were given answer models, closed and strict, so an answer that does not match is an error rather than silently passing; writes were left untyped because a stored answer replayed for a repeated request may have an older shape (ADR-006); openapi-typescript 7.13.0 is used with an override because it does not yet name TypeScript 6 as supported
context: Decided by an agent while building what the founder asked for on 2026-10-08; implemented and awaiting his review
chosen_option: Types for six read operations; the rest left open
rationale: Routes return untyped objects throughout; typing all of them is a larger change and needs a decision on stored answers first
